description: Billy Ho is a popular modern Japanese restaurant and cocktail bar located in the heart of Canggu, Bali. Conceptually designed by acclaimed celebrity chef Will Meyrick, the venue blends Japanese precision with a lively Bali energy, featuring a moody, sophisticated aesthetic with dark tones and comfortable lounge seating.
